Conditional three-priority beta integrations give the stated one-sided shifts and telescoping B(ℓ)=−1/3+2/[(ℓ+1)(ℓ+2)], yielding exact interior covariance −1/9+2/[3r(r+1)]+2/[3(n-r+1)(n-r+2)]. Endpoint beta integrals yield −(n−2)/(2n); all-n sign and total covariance follow by inequalities and telescoping. Independently reconstructed all BSTs for every insertion order n=2..7 with rational covariances and matched each rank; finite enumeration corroborates the unconditional all-n proof, not a replacement.
